content.body: Someone from the Chinese translation community (iirc) just opened 25 PRs or so. They look rather accurate too.
Yeah I saw those too. They probably could have done them all in one branch on one PR, but I’m not complaining. They’re all good fixes.

Does anybody know what happened to step 13-22 to `main fetch`? https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-main-fetch Is this maybe a bug in Bikeshed counting list items? It seems suspicious to me that step 12 is followed by step 23.
